The ambulance took my aunt to this hospital with anaphylaxis. I was sent with her because I was the only one who could speak fluent English. We were very scared and under a lot of stress.
I am very grateful to the doctors, nurses and all the other workers. Each person was  very professional, calm and willing to help.
I also wanted to mention that medical service charge for a foreigner was very affordable.
Thank you very much!

No one came to see me for over an hour. I was in severe pain and trauma. When I asked for a supervisor, they said there weren't any and I had to wait, even though my grandmother's pain was getting worse. They didn't respond to my questions. Those who arrived after us had long since seen the doctor and left. This attitude is borderline good and bad. I urge management to pay attention to this.

I am deeply disappointed with the service provided. Considering the high medical and service fees charged, patients should be treated with professionalism and respect. However, the manner in which customers were treated felt dismissive, as though we were seeking treatment free of charge. In addition, the nurse appeared inattentive and unprofessional while providing information, leaning back in her chair in an inappropriate manner. Such conduct is unacceptable for a private hospital and does not reflect the standard of care and service that patients should receive. 👎

Very happy with doctor Sutheethorn T, I was very worried because I had so much vomiting during my pregnancy but after meeting Doc and making Ultra sound I felt a relief. I must recommend her, and also very happy that Doc took the time and did not rush my appointment. Thank you so much!!! Alexandra
I am deeply impressed with the services provided by this hospital. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking quality healthcare.🥰 …

Recently visited this hospital and very impressed with service and quality.
Friendly staff and Doctors very professional. Can recommend this place to anyone

Nice hospital, I came in with food poisoning and they sorted me out with an IV drip and some meds and I was out in a couple hours feeling so much better. We couldn't figure out the insurance on my end but I wasn't bothered as it only cost about £100gbp.

From the moment I entered to leaving the next day, the staff were all fantastic. Blood tests, chest xray, constant checks through the night on my BP... all of it delivered by extremely professional, caring staff, at every interaction.
From the orderlies, to the cleaners, to the brilliant nurses and doctors.
Happy, helpful and dedicated people.
Thank you Dibuk.

Very good service. The staff, nurses and doctors are professional and speak fluent English. Since the first time I reviewed Dibuk Hospital, and coming here a few times for family members, myself and friends, I can still say that they have very good service and there no long waiting times.

Everything from the moment you’re getting into the ER reception area to the moment you’re leaving the hospital - is great.
Well, maybe except the waiting part - but still, it was nothing comparing to Thalang Hospital.

First, what I would like to highlight is that - receptionist / nurses/ doctors/ pharmacists - all of them can speak decent English. As for the expat, who can’t speak Thai - this is really important part.

After taking the first registration- the receptionist informed me, that as a Thailand resident I can use my social security number and be taking care for basically as local Thai person - one more star goes here as well.

After that - Doc’s consultation/ explanation/ prescription took a little while, but ! - everyone actually knew what they were doing and I didn’t have to use a translator even once.

Since I got there, till the moment I could leave was 1,5 hours gap ( but then again, it was a live-queue, so no complaints here)

In the end - the pharmacist-lady gave me detailed  instructions about the drug, which doctor prescribed and even told me everything about the drug ( what can I mix it with, what group of drugs it comes from, how exactly it works etc)

Now, I know, that it is probably should be a bare minimum in hospitals all around the globe, but when you live in Asia for a while, you know, that sometimes language barrier accures, or else ( who knows- you know), anyhow, getting everything done and feeling taking are of - matters.

Last, but not least - not that pricy as Bangkok Hospital- so 5 well-deserved stars 🌟
Been twice to this hospital. Seen me immediately, same doctor. Very helpful. Fixed me both times. Good price. Will keep using this one

I went in with severe diareeha and vomiting. The staff and nurses were very good, but they didn't test everything to make sure what I had. They just gave me antibiotics without testing what bacteria /virus or even parasite I might have contracted... And I came to see the doctor on the same day and they made me pay again, even though hospitals in Bahrain or any other country would give a complimentary second visit if it's within a week of being there. The second time I saw the doctor she just saw my tests and told me we didn't find any virus or bacteria and paid her money for that 😂

I see a lot of mixed reviews. Maybe it depends on staff. Me and my wife went there for stomach infection or food poisoning. They got us an IV for dehydration and medicine. The cost was like 300usd / 10,000 baht each without insurance. We came at 8:30am and left around 10am. IV took about an hour to use up. Staff was very friendly and took good care of us. I don't know if this place is expensive or not, but we didn't really care because we felt so sick. Thank you everyone for your kindness.

I was admitted as an inpatient for 5 days.
The staff team provided very good and fast services.
They are so kind and friendly, always asking, talking with me and giving advices for a better health.
I appreciated everyone and all departments.
This is one of the best hospital in Phuket that i would recommend.

Beautiful hospital, impressive service  Social Security.
Have a delicious Back Canyon Coffee & Eatery. Delicious new restaurant  There is also a 7-11 to press as you wish.

Doctors are nice but the payment took me 3 hours. Horrible management, no cooperation . My insurance euro center/ ergo told me to go to this hospital and I will not need to pay. However, after all the checks, I had to wait in the payment desk because they need payment confirmation from my Insurance. My insurance told me over 5 times that they have confirmed also called the hospital multiple times but the staff was constantly telling me that they did not receive the confirmation which is not true. I was very sick with 38.5C fever and waiting for 3 hours for them to communicate between insurance company. They are extremely slow and very mean to customers. I have asked them multiple times that I feel really bad and if they can tell me where it got stuck, I can help and they did not give me any update and told me to sit only for over 2 hours. I definitely do not recommend this hospital for foreigners with insurance. If you are willing to pay your own it is ok but never with insurance. I saw all the bad reviews but had to come due to emergency. Biggest mistake ever. Thai people are very friendly and nice but people in this hospital(not the doctors) are really mean and not helpful at all. Definitely do not recommend

Came there with food poisoning. They send me to Emergency Room, 5 min later doctor came and check me. They took Blood and urine, after nurse came and did for me IV fluids (1 litre) and some injections. I stayed there 1 hour, and feel much better. After that they gave me some home medicines. I liked that hospital, nurses are polite and friendly. Also big plus that I have Thai insurance, didn’t pay anything:)

Strongly recommend. The staff took care our  family member in few minutes. All medical tests have been done within 2 hours with further recommendation what to do next. All spoke English. I’m really impressed!

Came here at 1:00 am for severe eye pain and blurred vision in one eye. Was in and out with medication and payment in less than hour. Everyone was so kind and took my pain seriously. They gave me immediate pain relief and determined the cause quickly and was only around 1,500 baht for everything with no insurance. Way less than what they would charge me in America

I can only say that the evaluation of this hospital is not very good. Its medical level is not comprehensive, the fees are high, and it often offers patients medical plans that are prone to errors for them to choose from.

This is the worst service I've ever used. The system is terrible. The nurses and staffs are rude. The wait is very long. I think if I'm seriously ill and have to wait this long for a doctor, it might get worse. The person who came first is allowed to sit and wait, but the person who came later is allowed to enter first.

Seriously the worst hospital my family and I went to. Do not go to these private hospitals, they are only out for your money. Very poor English for a hospital where all the tourists are supposed to be driven to. It feels intentional because …

After reading all the negative reviews i was really worried, especially as a foreigner but i was pleasantly surprised at how they managed everything. We were in and out within 1-2 hours including medication, xrays, check up, payment and getting the medication for home. I think its really a lucky dip depending on who you get at what time.

I think my illness cured itself just waiting for the lab results 🤣🤣 everything took so long. Seriously should have just gone to Bangkok Phuket Hospital. Thought it was a small issue, quick in and out with some meds. But ended up waiting and waiting the entire day! …

While on vacation in phukhet our infant granddaughter [less than 1 yr] got sick with high fever. Our hotel in Rawaii recommended Dibuk Hospital for 3 main reasons 1. They have got good pediatrician 2. They speak English 3. Have international standard. And all 3 were correct. In addition it was not expensive. They accept international medical insurance but you need pre approval email sent to them. Also what was interesting was the thoroughness and professionalism of the Dr. She asked for blood sample to check if the infant  had influenza or infection. Then she recommended appropriate treatment which was effective. Thank God. Total time spent at hospital was 3 hrs which could have been improved. There is a need to improve the process. We had to remind the nurse station all the time otherwise we could have been forgotten. By the way there is a Muslim prayer room which is a bonus to us and also a reasonably priced coffee shop. However the CAFETERIA is extremely bad. Overall the Dibuk hospital in Phukhet is recommended

text: Excellent hospital. Highly recommended especially for Farang (foreigner). Its highly affordable and excellent service. They speak rather good English too. I was in and out with medication in about 40minutes costing about AUD $95, with 3 medical professionals. This is VERY affordable. A General Doctor in Australia costs this much, let alone all the medication given. The medication is also very easily identified with exact instruction. Bring and wear a mask. If not "emergency" but is urgent, suggest go at random hours (e.g. the day I went at about 530am, no traffic, no patients). I picked this instead of Chalong as I believe that's public and longer wait times. I also picked this instead of a local doctor because I wanted to be seen then instead of waiting for an appointment

I mentioned something about funds and came back 20 mins later with a price of 7000 for a different test. Had an injection to kill the pain and some meds for 3500 baht

Next day i went to Mission hospital and saw a great female doctor and said its a build up of gas. Was in and out in an hour with meds for 800 baht.

Nice hospital and nice staff but felt like more of a business than a hospital with a focus on making money and health is secondary.

For a cheap local hospital i would go to mission or phuket international where the facilities are slightly better  but you pay for it. Or hopefully your insurance will.
